text: . In non-endemic areas ivermectin may be given every 3 to 6 months depending on the recurrence of symptoms or presence of microfilariae. Vector control with larvicides, continued for the life span of an adult worm, is used to interrupt the transmission of infection and was the main strategy for onchocerciasis control before the introduction of ivermectin.
